hello.speaker: registrar
hello.text: A patron cannot erase a superior claim by tearing up her own bond. I can record a dispute and suspend collection under this archive’s covenant, but I need both accounts and the ledger. No soul is accepted here as substitute payment.

choices.text: Petition for a stay of collection.
Would cancelling her bond free him?

instructions.speaker: registrar
instructions.text: Hear why Seris cannot release him. Hear what Rowan wants. Read the ledger and preserve the victim’s testimony. This process suspends enforcement; it does not declare either pact void.

warning.speaker: registrar
warning.text: No. That would activate the archlord’s claim. There is no safe release until that claim is suspended or defeated. Nothing has been signed or cancelled.

petition.speaker: registrar
petition.text: Both accounts are entered. Now the evidence.

missing.speaker: registrar
missing.text: The claim is disputed, but the evidence of abuse is missing. Preserve Mara’s testimony from the ledger, then return. You have lost no right to petition again.

grant.speaker: registrar
grant.text: The stay is entered. Neither claim may collect Rowan while this dispute remains before the archive. He may live apart from Seris and refuse her service. This protection comes from the archive’s covenant, not her permission. Ask him what he wants next.

granted.speaker: registrar
granted.text: The stay remains in force for this prologue. Speak to Rowan. Permanent freedom requires defeating both claims; the recorded names are the beginning of the restitution work.
